loops.minute_1: Click cookie → gain 1/click. Purchase first Cursor for 15 coins to start automation. Immediate feedback: +1 cookie animated, click sound, counter increments.
loops.minute_10: 10 Cursors = 1 cookie/sec passive income. Purchase Farms, Mines. Golden Cookies spawn randomly (7-10s window) for +77 cookies/s boost. Upgrades appear (Cursor x2 damage) purchased with passive income.
loops.hour_5: 10+ buildings active (Farms, Factories, Banks). Economy reaches ~10k cookies/sec. New buildings unlock every 100-500 cookies. Ascension system (reset for prestige multiplier) becomes available. Exponential progression sensation.
loops.endgame: Ascensions repeated for prestige stacking. Grandmapocalypse event triggered (new gameplay). No final victory condition; progression asymptotes toward collector optimization. Long-tail content: new mechanics unlock (Heralds, Prestige tiers).

objectives.player_goal: Maximize passive cookie generation and reach highest prestige level via Ascensions. Collect all buildings and upgrades. Experience exponential growth.

games.retention_answer: Progression visible and exponential: each session, buildings produce more cookies → new purchases available → sensation of growing power. Ascension system provides emotional reset while preserving prestige multiplier. Golden Cookies create minute-to-minute tension. No hard ending; game recognizes 'completion' via multiple Ascensions, but replayability remains infinite through optimization challenges.

loops.minute_1: Start with Stygius (sword weapon). Tutorial biome Tartarus introduces combat: attack enemy, dodge incoming damage. First boon offered (passive ability boost) from Hermes. Immediate chamber victory provides first reward (coins/pom upgrade).
loops.minute_10: Complete 3-4 chambers over ~10 minutes. Acquire 3-4 boons that synergize (e.g., Hermes speed + Ares damage scaling). Chamber doors offer choices: fight room, shop, repair station. First Mirror upgrade (meta-progression) between-run benefit visible.
loops.hour_5: Progress through 3 biomes (Tartarus → Asphodel → Elysium). Face end-of-biome bosses. Run duration extends to 35-60 minutes. Even on death, player gains Darkness currency (meta-currency) and Chthonic Keys for permanent unlocks. Mirror upgrades purchased feel meaningful.
loops.endgame: Escape achieved: reach final boss and defeat. Unlock true ending (lore reveal). Pact of Punishment system allows escalating difficulty customization (Heat system, 32 levels). Unlock new weapons (6 total), weapon aspects, and hidden abilities. 300+ boon combinations ensure high replayability. Thousands of hours potential.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat final boss and exit the underworld
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches zero (death ends current run)
objectives.player_goal: Escape the underworld by collecting powerful boons, surviving enemy encounters, and reaching final boss. Long-term: unlock all weapons, complete lore, master Pact of Punishment challenges.

games.retention_answer: Each run creates a unique build via random boon offerings: same boss fought 50 times plays differently due to RNG and player synergy choices. Meta-progression (Darkness, Keys) ensures every death is a step forward, never a setback. Pact of Punishment provides personal difficulty scaling and achievement ladder. Six weapons × multiple aspects × 300+ boon combos = theoretically infinite build variety. Community culture around speedruns and challenge builds sustains engagement.

loops.minute_1: Start as Ironclad (warrior class). Opening hand: 5 cards (basic Strikes and Defends). Face first weak enemy (~45 HP). Play cards from hand to deal damage or block incoming damage. First room victory offers card reward: choose 1 of 3 new cards to add to deck.
loops.minute_10: Complete 2-3 combats. Deck now contains ~8 unique cards. Relic offered as reward (passive permanent bonus). Optional elite fight available. Early synergies emerge (e.g., Pummel synergizes with Heavy Blade due to +Strength scaling). Potions begin appearing as one-time combat items.
loops.hour_5: Progress through Acts 2-3 over ~30-50 minutes. Deck stabilizes at 20-25 cards. Multiple relics active (e.g., Tough Bandages = block regenerates). Archetype crystallizes ('Strength deck' vs 'Scaling spells' vs 'Exhaust deck'). Key decision: remove weak cards from deck to tighten synergies. Shop visits allow strategic card upgrades and removal.
loops.endgame: Defeat Act 3 final boss = victory. Optional: collect all 3 colored keys during run to unlock Act 4 (Heart superboss, 750 HP). Ascension system (1-20 difficulty multipliers per character) available. Higher Ascensions add enemy buffs and card restrictions, ensuring long-tail challenge. Four playable characters with radically different mechanics.

objectives.victory_condition: Defeat the Act 3 final boss and reach the Spire's top
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches zero (death during any combat)
objectives.player_goal: Build a coherent deck through 3 Acts that scales enough to defeat progressively harder bosses. Optimize card synergies and relic choices.

objectives.victory_condition: Collect all 3 colored keys and defeat the Heart superboss (750 HP with 15-card-per-turn scaling cap)
objectives.defeat_condition: Health reaches zero during Heart fight
objectives.player_goal: Defeat the optional Heart superboss after collecting keys. Optional true ending for completionists.

games.retention_answer: Every run creates a unique deck from 20,000+ possible card combinations. RNG (card offerings, enemy generation) combined with player choice ensures high variance: two runs with same character follow completely different paths. Ascension ladder (1-20 per character × 4 characters) provides competitive difficulty progression. Community engagement via speedruns, challenge builds, and deck theorycrafting sustains engagement for thousands of hours. Clear victory condition (beat Act 3) yet optional superboss (Heart) for challenge-seekers.
